WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id,
           SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_range dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st ON sr.sr_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT s_store_id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT s_store_id, sales, profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS returns,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit_loss
        FROM store_sales_agg
        UNION ALL
        SELECT s_store_id,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               returns,
               profit_loss
        FROM store_returns_agg
    ) AS store_combined
    GROUP BY s_store_id
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS returns,
           SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_range dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, sales, profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS returns,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit_loss
        FROM catalog_sales_agg
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               returns,
               profit_loss
        FROM catalog_returns_agg
    ) AS catalog_combined
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_site.web_site_id,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ws_site.web_site_id
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_site.web_site_id,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    JOIN date_range dr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ws_site.web_site_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT web_site_id, sales, profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS returns,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit_loss
        FROM web_sales_agg
        UNION ALL
        SELECT web_site_id,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               returns,
               profit_loss
        FROM web_returns_agg
    ) AS web_combined
    GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY rollup (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
